body:
### What happens?

When using the DuckLake and SQLite extensions, DuckDB crashes when the progress bar is enabled and runs OK when it is not

### To Reproduce

```
.timer on

PRAGMA disable_progress_bar; --enable this to cause crash
PRAGMA explain_output='all';

INSTALL ducklake;
LOAD ducklake;
INSTALL sqlite;
LOAD sqlite;

SET memory_limit='1GB';
SET threads=1;
SET temp_directory='./tempfiles';

ATTACH 'ducklake:sqlite:metadata.sqlite' AS dl (DATA_PATH 'data_files/');

CREATE TABLE dl.metars AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('../raw_metars') LIMIT 0;

ALTER TABLE dl.metars SET PARTITIONED BY (YEAR(timeObs), MONTH(timeObs));
ALTER TABLE dl.metars SET SORTED BY (stationName ASC, timeObs ASC);

CALL dl.set_option('parquet_compression', 'zstd');
CALL dl.set_option('parquet_compression_level', 12);

INSERT INTO dl.metars SELECT * FROM read_parquet('../raw_metars/') ;
```

When I `cat` this into duckdb, eg `cat create.sql | duckdb`


Produces this crash when I run it with gdb:

```Thread 1 "duckdb" received signal SIGFPE, Arithmetic exception.
